The '''Research Outpost''',<ref name="SWG" /> also known as the '''Imperial Research Station''', was a research outpost established on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest moon of Endor]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was built by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] along with the [[Endor Space Station]] that provided services to the outpost.<ref name="Sony" /> Nevertheless, the Empire had almost no presence in the outpost, the area being patrolled by [[Mercenary|mercenaries]]. The Research Outpost was mainly used as a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] by [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] visiting the planet.<ref name="SWG" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kilnstrider]] of the Imperial [[Storm Squadron/Legends|Storm Squadron]] was based at the Research Outpost.<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref> The collector [[Jener Mich]] also resided in the outpost.<ref name="SWG:TCOA">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Meatlumps]], a gang of fanatical technology-hating criminals and terrorists from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], placed a bomb in the Research Outpost. Fortunately, a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who had infiltrated the group discovered the plot and defused the bomb before it could explode.<ref name="SWG:MEDS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Meatlump Explosive Device Sabotage}}</ref> The same year, another spacer visited the outpost and collected [[knuckles of the katarn]].<ref name="SWG:RMWMIII">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Rare Melee Weapons Mark III}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Research Outpost was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
